primaryRule: per arm, the actual-profit role of the arm's selectable set (its baseline with GDX OFF, its Appendix A control and its searched partners): the highest development centre net among qualified members (ties: selection robust net, centre DD, label)

R.set: arm R: the baseline (GDX OFF), the arm's Appendix A control and its searched partners

O.set: arm O: the baseline (GDX OFF), the arm's Appendix A control and its searched partners

G.set: arm G: the baseline (GDX OFF), the arm's Appendix A control and its searched partners

R.economicClass: risk/profit trade-off (qualified partners earn more or are locally more stable, none dominates)

O.economicClass: risk/profit trade-off (qualified partners earn more or are locally more stable, none dominates)

G.economicClass: stable addition on development (a qualified partner dominates the baseline)

recommendationRules.R: add GDX Growth to C4-refined only if arm R's partner candidate (the highest-net qualified GDX-enabled member dominating the baseline on development) exists, passes V1–V3 and is supported across later periods (validation P&L ≥ the baseline's); otherwise GDX Growth OFF remains preferable (the no-improvement fallback). No second candidate is promoted; validation never chooses a different member.
recommendationRules.O: add GDX Growth to C4 only if arm O's partner candidate (the highest-net qualified GDX-enabled member dominating the baseline on development) exists, passes V1–V3 and is supported across later periods (validation P&L ≥ the baseline's); otherwise GDX Growth OFF remains preferable (the no-improvement fallback). No second candidate is promoted; validation never chooses a different member.
recommendationRules.G: add GDX Growth to VGT Growth #4 alone only if arm G's partner candidate (the highest-net qualified GDX-enabled member dominating the baseline on development) exists, passes V1–V3 and is supported across later periods (validation P&L ≥ the baseline's); otherwise GDX Growth OFF remains preferable (the no-improvement fallback). No second candidate is promoted; validation never chooses a different member.
